s.note: Fiery hot wings, cooling ranch, celery. Liquid heat, for payback.
s.how: Dry the wings well and toss with the baking powder and salt. Bake on a rack at 220C, turning once, until crisp. Melt the butter with the hot sauce, cayenne and honey. Toss the wings in the sauce and serve with ranch and celery.

s.note: Slow pulled pork, slaw, soft rolls. The Alpha Betas let pigs into the party.
s.how: Rub the pork with the sugar, paprika, garlic powder and salt. Put it in a lidded pot with a cup of water and cook at 150C until it falls apart. Shred the pork and stir through the barbecue sauce and half the vinegar. Toss the cabbage with mayo and the remaining vinegar. Pile the pork and slaw into the buns.

m.note: Spiced lamb, tzatziki, tomato, onion, warm pita. The nerds finally get taken in.
m.how: Toss the lamb with two thirds of the garlic, the oregano, paprika, lemon juice, oil and salt. Mix the yoghurt with the cucumber, the remaining garlic and salt. Bake the chips until crisp. Sear the lamb in batches in a very hot pan until charred at the edges. Warm the pitas and wrap with lamb, tzatziki, tomato, onion and a few chips.

m.note: Bacon-wrapped franks, beans, salsa, jalapeno. Freshman year at Adams College, Tucson.
m.how: Wrap each frankfurt tightly in a rasher of bacon. Cook in a hot pan, turning, until the bacon is crisp all over. Warm the beans and the rolls. Fill the rolls with the franks, then beans, tomato, onion, jalapenos, mustard and a stripe of mayo.

w.note: Eat a pie for charity, says Takashi. Biscuit crust, banana custard, whipped cream.
w.how: Mix the biscuit crumbs with the butter and press into 4 small pie tins, then chill. Whisk the yolks, sugar and cornflour, pour on the hot milk, then stir over heat until thick and add the vanilla. Cool the custard with plastic wrap on the surface. Layer banana and custard in the crusts. Whip the cream and pile it high on top.

d.note: Pineapple, lime and dry ginger, lots of ice. Judy's Omega Mus save the party.
d.how: Stir the pineapple juice and lime juice in a punch bowl. Add the orange slices and ice. Top with the dry ginger just before serving.
